projects.name: Intelligent OCR & Document Processing System
projects.short_summary: An end-to-end OCR pipeline engineered to process low-quality documents and extract structured textual details.
projects.engineering_solution: Applied advanced image preprocessing configurations with OpenCV to deskew and denoise low-res inputs before executing PaddleOCR text localization chunks.
key_highlights: Built modular, scalable end-to-end OCR processing blocks (PDF -> Image -> Preprocessing -> OCR -> Output).
Developed custom image preprocessing sub-routines tailored specifically for heavily noisy layout formats.

quantifiable_metrics.accuracy_gain: Improved text extraction accuracy by ~25-30% on noisy and unformatted layout inputs.

projects.name: AI Document Assistant (RAG-based GenAI System)
projects.short_summary: A context-aware document Q&A application built to minimize manual search cycles through semantic index architectures.
projects.engineering_solution: Combined PaddleOCR and OpenCV for initial document text extraction, passing parsed vectors to LangChain RAG pipes with a ChromaDB semantic backend store.
key_highlights: Enabled context-aware conversational interactions over unformatted document files.
Deployed clean inference endpoint wrappers via FastAPI architecture structures to serve real-time user prompts.

quantifiable_metrics.efficiency_gain: Significantly reduced manual search efforts through structured vector context injection queries.

projects.name: Customer Churn Prediction Pipeline
projects.short_summary: A classical machine learning classification pipeline constructed to accurately compute user churn analytics thresholds.
projects.engineering_solution: Executed clean feature engineering and data preprocessing via Pandas and NumPy, routing matrix shapes to a Scikit-Learn classification wrapper.
key_highlights: Integrated robust validation techniques and standard evaluation matrices to check predictive models stability.
Visualized feature weights and performance breakdowns using customized Matplotlib layouts.

quantifiable_metrics.stability: Optimized classification confidence metrics and model reliability profiles using multi-fold validation checks.

projects.name: AI Model API Deployment Engine
projects.short_summary: A reusable backend server infrastructure built to wrap model parameters inside production APIs.
projects.engineering_solution: Constructed asynchronous FastAPI gateways processing structured JSON tokens for instant inference processing integration layers.
key_highlights: Designed scalable network endpoints optimized for low-latency operational cycles.
Structured reusable backend code workflows to streamline future model integrations.

quantifiable_metrics.concurrency: Enables robust real-time inference processing hooks across decoupled frontend system endpoints.
